author: OzzieMLGz
body:
Hi Avicus. I'm writing this to appeal to a ban. I was banned for using Aimbot on February 14, 2015. I know this was a long time ago but I really loved this server and I want a chance to play back on it. So please can you guys please give me another chance.
I vow and swear never to hack or say anything rude or inappropriate. So please give me another chance. Thanks for reading this ban appeal and I hope you unban me. My email is OzziePlayzMC@gmail.com. Thanks

Regards,
